text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This single strike!
It is an absolute, peerless blow!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even if there is no one running beside me!
No matter how sturdy these stone walls may be!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—I will strike you down!!
Soryaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason! It's No Reason!!
The one who grasped the imperial banner is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason!
She conquers the Autumn Tenno Sho!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*... *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her victory, No Reason was breathing heavily,
looking like a defeated warrior fleeing from battle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'll hand over... this era...!
I'll snatch it back with my own hands, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Snatching it away. That part is fine.
With today's running, you could likely do it.
However, even so—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Can my body truly endure a series of fierce battles like today's? And—)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Even after usurping the realm, the warlords will still come slashing at me.)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Isolated and without aid, just how long can they withstand such a fierce onslaught...?)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The path is a troublesome one, indeed.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! I'll show them!
Even if I have to do it all on my own! Nwa-hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hearty burst of loud laughter. No Reason had triumphantly
become the champion of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few weeks later—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A heartbreaking 3rd place for Neo Universe!
Though her dream of the Triple Crown is shattered, she sets her sights on even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Landing Failure."
Neo Universe couldn't reach it.
However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: To the Japan Cup... "Following in the ancients' footsteps," is it?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love-san,
congratulations on winning the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that—the 'Shuka Sho'.
Ah, the sweet, luscious taste of this nectar...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I may spread my wings?
All the better... to drain you completely♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Two crowns... and the Triple Tiara...
To think that five out of the six crowns
are in the hands of the Silent Clan...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Moreover, it seems the remaining crown was also won
by someone tied to the Silent Clan..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow them to advance any further!
I will not let the Silent Clan, or anyone else, take it...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hold everything, this is an emergency!! Trainer, we make haste—to the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In this decisive battle to determine the best in Japan,
we shall halt their advance!
choice_data_list: Still, is your body holding up alright?!
Still, are you feeling alright physically?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is only one month left
between the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
and the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with double crown Umamusume Neo Universe joining in, there's a high chance this will be the clash of the century, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How can I just stand by and watch?!
The fire has already reached our main keep!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: If she takes the Japan Cup too, my era will be in even greater jeopardy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of the battle... is unpredictable.
Yet, no matter what happens...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—You'll come with me, won't you?
I have... no one left but you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The general has made up their mind.
In that case—I have only to follow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason aiming for an upset victory. But,
just as glory was within reach—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The fierce arrows of the next generation come raining down.
The dream stage of the Japan Cup
turns into a desperate, final defense."
